title: Lovász row array
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$ and Boolean lists $w$ and $r$, define an $n$-by-$n$ array of natural numbers whose $(i,j)$ entry, for $0\le i,j<n$, is the natural number encoded by the length-$k$ block of $r$ starting at position $(ni+j)k$ if the bit of $w$ at position $ni+j$ is true, and is zero otherwise. Missing bits of $w$ are treated as false, and the block is truncated if $r$ ends before its full length.
